info.title: Magic HTML Tier 1 APIs
info.description: Independent styling, forms, content, collection, media, illustration, deterministic semantic document templates, replay-safe fixed and generic intake interviews, knowledge retrieval, tenant-isolated CRM and Messaging, bounded outbound Channel publishing, tenant-safe Measurement and Presence reporting and confirmed writes, isolated remote site-source acquisition, approval, static-site import, safe static-page target inspection and editing, and isolated preview services.

200.description: Filled HTML derived from the pinned template

409.description: The key already represents another definition

201.description: Created intake session and temporary signed URL

post.description: The independently deployed Content and Collection services expose the same route on their own origins.

get.description: Read from the Content or Collection service origin that owns the version.

200.description: Authenticated draft or published media bytes

404.description: Media is absent or not published

post.description: Deterministically inspect caller-supplied HTML for finite text, image, and contact-link edit targets. This synchronous operation performs no external communication, persistence, or mutation.

200.description: Bounded editable targets and the digest to bind a later edit

401.description: Missing or invalid service Bearer credential

422.description: The supplied HTML or request fields are invalid

post.description: Apply a finite, structure-preserving operation list to caller-supplied HTML. The service owns no site source or deployment credentials.

409.description: The supplied base digest does not match the HTML or an operation violates the structural editing boundary

post.description: Classify and normalize caller-resolved source bytes. GitHub, SFTP, FTPS, and FTP credentials remain in separate source adapters; this service receives no credentials and performs no outbound connection.

422.description: The file set is invalid, unsafe, too large, or contains no importable static files

post.description: Store a short-lived, self-contained StaticSite snapshot on an isolated preview origin.

422.description: The file set or entry path is invalid or unsafe

post.description: Render the isolated preview in a real headless browser and return image bytes.

503.description: The configured browser renderer is temporarily unavailable

200.description: Short-lived preview file with an operation-specific content type

post.description: Start a private scripted interview that accumulates a structured website brief. The key is scoped by site; an exact retry replays the original 201 response and changed input returns 409.

201.description: Active interview session, or the exact idempotent response replayed

post.description: Register an already collected structured website brief as a completed interview session. Idempotency-Key is optional; when supplied, an exact retry returns the existing session and changed input returns 409.

200.description: Existing completed session replayed for the supplied Idempotency-Key

get.description: Read the messages, current question, and structured data for one private interview session.

delete.description: Delete one private interview authoring session.

post.description: Answer the active session's expected current scripted step and advance its structured brief. The key is scoped by site and session; exact retries replay the original response, while changed input, concurrent work, stale steps, and completed sessions return 409 without advancing twice.

200.description: Advanced interview session, or the exact idempotent response replayed

post.description: Create one private knowledge base in the authenticated tenant scope.

201.description: Knowledge base created, or the exact idempotent response replayed

get.description: Read one knowledge base only within its authenticated tenant scope.

post.description: Accept resolved document bytes and bounded metadata, then extract, chunk, and index them asynchronously. The service performs no caller-directed remote fetch.

file.description: Resolved document bytes, limited to 50 MiB before extraction.

202.description: Ingestion accepted, or the exact idempotent job replayed

get.description: Read an ingestion job only within the tenant and knowledge-base scope that owns it.

post.description: Search one fixed knowledge-base revision using deterministic weighted reciprocal-rank fusion of semantic and keyword ranks.
Return an answer supported by explicit citations from this knowledge base, or refuse when the indexed evidence is insufficient or conflicting.

get.description: List active companies in one tenant. Search text is treated as a literal substring and ordering is stabilized by the record UUID in the selected direction.

post.description: Create a company in one tenant. Corporate number uniqueness is tenant-local and includes soft-deleted records.

201.description: Company created, or the exact completed response replayed

Location.description: Canonical URL of the company resource.

get.description: Read one active company only within its tenant scope; missing and cross-tenant records return the same not-found Problem.

patch.description: Update at least one company field when expected_version matches, then increment the version exactly once.

200.description: Company updated, or the exact completed response replayed

delete.description: Soft-delete the company when expected_version matches. Linked people are not cascaded.

200.description: Company deleted, or the exact completed response replayed

get.description: List active people in one tenant, optionally limited to an active company in that same tenant. Search is literal and ordering is stabilized by UUID.

post.description: Create a person in one tenant, optionally linked to an active company in that same tenant.

201.description: Person created, or the exact completed response replayed

Location.description: Canonical URL of the person resource.

get.description: Read one active person only within its tenant scope; missing and cross-tenant records return the same not-found Problem.

patch.description: Update at least one person field when expected_version matches, then increment the version exactly once. company_id may be null or an active company in the same tenant.

200.description: Person updated, or the exact completed response replayed

delete.description: Soft-delete the person when expected_version matches.

200.description: Person deleted, or the exact completed response replayed

get.description: List provider-independent channels in one tenant, ordered by created_at and UUID descending.

post.description: Create a normalized channel. credential_reference is encrypted at rest and never returned; responses expose only credentials_configured.

201.description: Channel created, or exact completed response replayed

get.description: Read a channel only within its tenant; missing and cross-tenant identifiers return the same Problem.
List conversations scoped to both tenant and channel, ordered by created_at and UUID descending.

post.description: Create one open conversation under the tenant-scoped channel. A non-null provider conversation identifier is unique within that channel.

201.description: Conversation created, or exact completed response replayed

get.description: Read a conversation only when both the channel and conversation belong to the tenant scope.
List normalized messages in a tenant-owned conversation, ordered by created_at and UUID descending.

post.description: Persist one normalized outbound message and invoke the runtime-bound DeliveryAdapter once. Exact retries return the stored response without redelivery. Slack uses the fixed chat.postMessage endpoint; ambiguous outcomes are returned as unknown and are never auto-retried.

201.description: Message delivered, or exact completed response replayed without redelivery

post.description: Authenticate the exact raw body with Slack v0 HMAC, enforce a five-minute timestamp window, deduplicate event_callback by channel and event_id plus raw-body digest, and persist only normalized inbound fields. Callback-looking URLs remain inert data and are never executed or persisted.

202.description: Event normalized, ignored, or exact provider event replay deduplicated

get.description: List credential-redacted connections in deterministic newest-first order with UUID tie-breaking.

post.description: Create a provider connection. Credentials are encrypted, write-only, and never returned; provider endpoints are server-owned.

201.description: Connection created or exact response replayed

get.description: Return one credential-redacted connection from the tenant scope.

patch.description: Optimistically update a connection. Credential rotation increments credential_version and invalidates verification.

200.description: Connection updated or exact response replayed

delete.description: Soft-delete a version-matched connection only when no queued or dispatching publication uses it.

200.description: Connection deleted or exact response replayed

post.description: Resolve encrypted credentials and perform a read-only identity lookup at the fixed provider endpoint before atomically marking the exact credential version verified.

200.description: Connection verified or exact response replayed

post.description: Stream one bounded MP4 into private service storage. No caller path or remote video URL is accepted or fetched.

201.description: Private artifact created or exact response replayed

get.description: Return safe immutable artifact metadata without a storage disk, path, or public URL.
List normalized publication state in deterministic newest-first order with UUID tie-breaking.

post.description: Create one immutable provider-specific publication against a currently verified connection and enqueue one single-attempt delivery job.

202.description: Publication queued or exact response replayed without another job

get.description: Return normalized queued, terminal, or ambiguous delivery state without raw provider envelopes.

post.summary: Create a provider connection with write-only credentials

get.summary: Read a tenant-scoped connection without secrets

patch.summary: Update mutable connection fields and invalidate verification when provider material changes

post.summary: Verify credentials and configured resource through a fixed provider endpoint
Run a bounded Search Console report
Run a bounded Google Business Profile performance report

get.summary: List a bounded page of GTM or GBP resources

post.summary: Execute a confirmed optimistic GTM or GBP mutation exactly once

get.description: List credential-redacted source connections in one tenant and site scope.

post.description: Create a driver-closed connection. Credentials are encrypted at rest and never returned.

201.description: Connection created or exact response replayed

200.description: Connection updated or exact response replayed

204.description: Connection deleted or exact response replayed

200.description: Bounded verification result or exact response replayed

post.description: Queue one bounded fetch from the configured source. The returned job eventually references an immutable, self-contained snapshot.

202.description: Fetch queued or exact job response replayed

get.description: Return the immutable resolved file snapshot for direct ingestion by Site Import. No source credential or remote locator is present.
List approval requests within one tenant and site scope. The trusted caller is responsible for authorizing the principal for this scope.

post.description: Create one review request for an immutable artifact tuple. preview_url is descriptive and is never fetched by this service.

201.description: Approval request created, or the exact idempotent response replayed

post.description: Append an attributed message. Messages remain appendable after a final decision.

201.description: Message audit event created, or the exact idempotent response replayed

post.description: Record the first and only final approved or rejected decision. A rejection requires a non-empty message.

200.description: Final decision recorded, or the exact idempotent response replayed

get.description: Return ordered audit events and server-side keyed-hash verification. Hash values are opaque; consumers must reject a history whose integrity.valid is false.

serviceBearer.description: A trusted service credential. The caller authenticates and authorizes end users for tenant/site scope and asserts actor identity.

slackHmacV0.name: X-Slack-Signature
slackHmacV0.description: Slack v0 HMAC-SHA256 of v0:timestamp:exact_raw_body using the channel's runtime-resolved signing secret. X-Slack-Request-Timestamp is also required and limited to a 300-second skew.

InterviewIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
InterviewIdempotencyKey.description: Optional import idempotency key. Exact retries return the existing completed session; reuse for changed input returns 409.

InterviewWriteIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
InterviewWriteIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque start or answer key scoped to the relevant site and, for answers, interview session. Exact retries replay the original status and body; changed input or work already in progress returns 409.

KnowledgeBase.name: knowledgeBase
KnowledgeBase.description: Knowledge base UUID resolved together with the tenant scope; cross-tenant lookup must return 404.

KnowledgeIngestionJob.name: ingestionJob
KnowledgeIngestionJob.description: Ingestion job UUID resolved together with tenant and knowledge-base scope.

KnowledgeIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
KnowledgeIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to the authenticated tenant and operation. Exact retries replay the original response; reuse with changed input returns 409.

CrmCompany.name: company
CrmCompany.description: Company UUID resolved together with tenant scope; missing, deleted, and cross-tenant records return 404.

CrmPerson.name: person
CrmPerson.description: Person UUID resolved together with tenant scope; missing, deleted, and cross-tenant records return 404.

CrmIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
CrmIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to the tenant. Exact retries of the same operation and input replay the completed response; reuse for changed input, another operation, or work in progress returns 409.

CrmSearch.name: q
CrmSearch.description: Literal substring search, bounded to 200 characters.

CrmCompanyFilter.name: company_id
CrmCompanyFilter.description: An active company UUID in the same tenant.

TenantUuid.name: tenant
TenantUuid.description: Messaging tenant UUID. Every resource lookup is resolved together with this scope.

MessagingChannel.name: channel
MessagingChannel.description: Channel UUID resolved within the tenant; cross-tenant identifiers return 404.

MessagingConversation.name: conversation
MessagingConversation.description: Conversation UUID resolved within tenant and, where present, channel scope.

MessagingIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
MessagingIdempotencyKey.description: Key scoped to tenant and resource operation. Exact retries replay the stored response without another delivery; changed input or active work returns 409.

SlackRequestTimestamp.name: X-Slack-Request-Timestamp
SlackRequestTimestamp.description: Decimal Unix timestamp within 300 seconds of server time.

SlackSignature.name: X-Slack-Signature
SlackSignature.description: Lowercase Slack v0 HMAC-SHA256 signature over timestamp and exact raw request bytes.

ChannelConnection.name: connection
ChannelConnection.description: Connection UUID resolved together with tenant scope; missing, deleted, and cross-tenant records return 404.

ChannelMediaArtifact.name: artifact
ChannelMediaArtifact.description: Private media artifact UUID resolved together with tenant scope.

ChannelPublication.name: publication
ChannelPublication.description: Publication UUID resolved together with tenant scope.

ChannelIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
ChannelIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque 8-200 character key scoped to tenant, resource, and operation. Exact retries replay the original response without another provider call or queue job; changed input or active work returns 409.

MeasurementTenant.name: tenant
MeasurementTenant.description: Measurement tenant scope. Every connection and provider operation is resolved together with this identifier.

MeasurementConnection.name: connection
MeasurementConnection.description: Measurement connection UUID resolved within tenant scope; cross-tenant identifiers return 404.

MeasurementWritableProvider.name: provider
MeasurementWritableProvider.description: Provider surface that exposes resource listing and confirmed mutations.

MeasurementIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
MeasurementIdempotencyKey.description: 8-200 byte key scoped to tenant and connection. Exact completed retries replay the stored response; changed input returns 409 and an ambiguous in-progress outcome remains blocked until reconciliation.

SiteSourceConnection.name: connection
SiteSourceConnection.description: Source connection UUID resolved together with tenant and site; cross-scope lookup returns 404.

SiteSourceFetchJob.name: fetchJob
SiteSourceFetchJob.description: Fetch job UUID resolved together with tenant, site, and connection.

SiteSourceIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
SiteSourceIdempotencyKey.description: Opaque write key scoped to tenant, site, resource, and operation. Exact retries replay the original response; changed input or active work returns 409.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque globally unique key. Exact retries replay the original status and body; reuse for another operation or input returns 409.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Whether this response is an exact replay of a completed operation.

MeasurementRateLimited.description: Measurement request throttled by Laravel middleware
